scripts.text: We're looking for adventurers that can join us for a brand new adventure. If you're at the Level to accept IGU's quests, then you're qualified.
scripts.translation: 我們正在招募冒險者，和我們一起開啟全新的旅程。只要等級達到接受IGU任務的要求，就符合資格。

scripts.text: I'm Roel, new member of the White Wings Guild. Roter had me search everywhere for Newoz, and I've found some clues as to his whereabouts.
scripts.translation: 我是羅埃爾，白翼公會的新成員。羅特讓我四處尋找紐奧茲，我也找到了一些有關他下落的線索。

scripts.text: Recruiting guild prospects! Join us in our search for our former master Newoz! Are you interested?
scripts.translation: 正在招募公會成員！加入我們，一起尋找我們的前任會長紐奧茲！您有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: What a difficult task. I searched from this end to that end of the world, and could find neither hide nor hair of him.
scripts.translation: 真是艱鉅的任務。我搜遍了世界的每一個角落，卻連他的影子都沒找到。

scripts.text: I tried to some trace of him, but to no avail.
scripts.translation: 我試圖追蹤他的蹤跡，但毫無結果。

scripts.text: Newoz is an avid adventurer who never stays in one place long enough; a lot of people claimed they saw him, yet none of them remembered where he went.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲是一位熱衷冒險的人，他從不長久停留在一個地方。很多人聲稱見過他，但沒人記得他去了哪裡。

scripts.text: After a while, I had to give up on tracing him. I was just wasting time.
scripts.translation: 過了一段時間，我不得不放棄追蹤他。那只是在浪費時間。

scripts.text: I turned my eyes to the Other World, and there I met some eyewitnesses. They led me to the last place Newoz had been seen.
scripts.translation: 我將目光投向了異世界，在那裡我遇到了一些目擊者。他們指引我找到了紐奧茲最後出現的地方。

scripts.text: The whole process was painful. If it weren't for Runane, we couldn't have Memorized his last location or gotten out of it.
scripts.translation: 這一路真是吃盡苦頭。要不是露娜恩，我們根本記不住他最後出現的位置，也無法從那裡脫身。

scripts.text: If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane. We have an exciting adventure ahead of us.
scripts.translation: 如果您有興趣加入我們，請去和露娜恩談談。我們前方有一段令人興奮的冒險。

scripts.text: If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane.
scripts.translation: 如果您有興趣加入我們，請去和露娜恩談談。

scripts.text: It was my first adventure as a member of White Wings. I can't wait for the next one!
scripts.translation: 這是我作為白翼公會成員的第一次冒險。我迫不及待想要迎接下一次冒險了！

scripts.text: Where do you think Shaloshi is by now? The space where we met Shaloshi is caught in a time loop, repeating the same events again and again.
scripts.translation: 你覺得沙洛希現在在哪兒？我們遇見她的那個空間陷入了時間迴圈，同樣的事件一遍遍重複。

scripts.text: Mingmin thinks the phenomenon has something to do with the Dimensional Crack and Shaloshi's ability.
scripts.translation: 明敏認為這種現象與次元裂縫以及沙洛希的能力有關。

scripts.text: I didn't quite understand her, but Runane said the portal to the place she Memorized is based on time instead of space.
scripts.translation: 我沒太聽懂她的意思，不過露娜恩說，通往她記憶中那個地點的傳送門是以時間而非空間為基礎的。

scripts.text: If you want, you can go back in time and experience the same events. Do you want to embark on an adventure again?
scripts.translation: 如果您願意，可以回到過去，體驗同樣的事件。您想再次踏上冒險之旅嗎？

scripts.text: You might have a different experience this time in this place full of unfathomable mysteries. Please ask Runane to open the portal for you.
scripts.translation: 在這個充滿不可思議之謎的地方，您這次可能會有不同的體驗。請讓露娜恩為您開啟傳送門。

scripts.text: This time, maybe you don't have to leave Shaloshi.
scripts.translation: 這一次，也許您不必離開沙洛希了。

scripts.text: Are you ready yet? You can give up if you're not confident.
scripts.translation: 您準備好了嗎？如果您沒有信心，也可以放棄。

scripts.text: Adventuring is always fun. Be a great adventurer, okay?
scripts.translation: 冒險總是充滿樂趣的。要成為偉大的冒險者哦。

scripts.text: Our adventure hasn't started yet, and I'm already hungry.
scripts.translation: 我們的冒險還沒開始，我就已經餓了。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: I told you, Newoz. We can't just let this go.
scripts.translation: 我告訴過你，紐奧茲。我們不能就這樣算了。

scripts.text: Considering the time and money we wasted on you, you deserve to be fed a basket full of poisonous mushrooms.
scripts.translation: 考慮到我們為你浪費的時間和金錢，你值得被喂一籃子毒蘑菇。

scripts.text: I'll explain everything. And enough with the poisonous mushrooms. I can't eat mushrooms at all.
scripts.translation: 我會把一切都解釋清楚。還有，別再提毒蘑菇了，我根本不能吃蘑菇。

scripts.text: Newoz, you can't eat anything but meat. Sigh, I'm glad you're safe.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你只能吃肉。唉，很高興你平安無事。

scripts.text: You're the famous Newoz! Nice to meet you. My master told me many great things...
scripts.translation: 你就是著名的紐奧茲！很高興見到你。我的師父跟我說過很多關於你的好事...

scripts.text: Enough. He's just an idiot with no sense of direction.
scripts.translation: 夠了。他只是一個沒有方向感的笨蛋。

scripts.text: Wow, Newoz! Your eyes look puffier than ever.
scripts.translation: 哇，紐奧茲！你的眼睛看起來比以往更腫了。

scripts.text: Hello, Arang. How's Arirang? Heh. What brings you here?
scripts.translation: 你好，阿朗。阿里朗怎麼樣了？呵。是什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？

scripts.text: Newoz, do you know how long you've been missing? We even recruited new guildsmen to find you, and...
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你知道你失蹤多久了嗎？我們甚至招募了新的公會成員來找你，而且...

scripts.text: Hi, nice to meet you. I'm honored to meet the famous Newoz in person.
scripts.translation: 你好，很高興見到你。能親眼見到著名的紐奧茲，我感到很榮幸。

scripts.text: H-hello, my name is Roel. Runane and I've joined the guild together. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你...你好，我叫羅埃爾。我和露娜恩一起加入了公會。很高興見到你。

scripts.text: In accordance with the Guild Policy, Article 8, I'm now the master of this guild, and you're just a member.
scripts.translation: 根據公會政策第8條，我現在是這個公會的會長，而你只是一個成員。

scripts.text: ...That wasn't what I expected. Aren't you upset at all?
scripts.translation: ...這不是我預期的反應。你一點都不生氣嗎？

scripts.text: What did you expect? All he thinks about is adventure, monsters, and treasure.
scripts.translation: 你期待什麼？他滿腦子想的只有冒險、魔物和寶物。

scripts.text: Argh, is there a ghost? Or am I hearing things?
scripts.translation: 啊，有幽靈嗎？還是我聽錯了？

scripts.text: Whew, it's you Jack. Long time, no see, everyone.
scripts.translation: 呼，原來是傑克啊。好久不見了，各位。

scripts.text: This isn't a good time for chit-chat. I'm sensing something from the very floor where you're standing and where I'm hiding.
scripts.translation: 現在不是閒聊的時候。我感覺到你腳下和我躲藏的地方有什麼不對勁。

scripts.text: Jack, is that why you're hiding like a coward?
scripts.translation: 傑克，你像膽小鬼一樣躲起來是因為這個嗎？

scripts.text: It comes natural for veteran thieves like me to hide themselves in potential enemy territories.
scripts.translation: 像我這樣的老練盜賊，在潛在的敵對區域隱藏自己可是本能。

scripts.text: I'm not hiding because my sprite is not yet ready!
scripts.translation: 我躲起來才不是因為角色形象還沒做好！

scripts.text: I agree with Jack. Everything about this place--from the air to the soil--screams unnatural.
scripts.translation: 我同意傑克的看法。這個地方的一切——從空氣到土壤——都透著不自然。
或者是來自異世界的東西。

scripts.text: You're Lagi, right? I like the way you think. I'd love to work with you sometime.
scripts.translation: 你是拉吉吧？我喜歡你的思維方式。希望以後能有機會與你合作。

scripts.text: I've joined this guild to meet you, Newoz. Do you have a girlfriend?
scripts.translation: 我加入這個公會就是為了見到你，紐奧茲。你有女朋友嗎？

scripts.text: Don't you dare--I called dibs on him first!
scripts.translation: 你敢——他可是我先看上的！

scripts.text: I don't think he knows that. Do you, Newoz?
scripts.translation: 我覺得他應該不知道吧。紐奧茲，是這樣嗎？
*哼* 那他就是名正言順的獵物了！

scripts.text: Um, the conversation seems to have gone...
She can change subjects more quickly than an Arclouse can cast Increase AGI.
scripts.translation: 她轉換話題的速度比阿庫羅斯施放敏捷提升術還快。

scripts.text: Are they competing over Newoz? I want in, too!
scripts.translation: 她們是在爭搶紐奧茲嗎？我也要加入！

scripts.text: ...Sorry to bother you guys, but I think something's over there.
scripts.translation: ...抱歉打擾大家，我覺得那邊有什麼東西。

scripts.text: Perhaps it's monsters. Do you want me to go check?
scripts.translation: 也許是魔物。需要我去檢視一下嗎？

scripts.text: You stay here, kiddo. I'll go.
Newoz, you're like a magnet for crazy.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你就像個瘋狂磁鐵。

scripts.text: I can see what has made you become so irritable, Master.
scripts.translation: 我明白了，師父，這就是您變得如此易怒的原因。

scripts.text: Oh, shut it, both of you!
That reminds me, when Rot was younger...
scripts.translation: 這讓我想起，羅特小時候...

scripts.text: Rot? Is that your pet name, Master? Are you two friends?
scripts.translation: 羅特？那是師父的綽號嗎？你們兩個是朋友？

scripts.text: That Crack thing, or the entrance as you might call it, has vanished. If you really want to leave, then follow Aigu.
scripts.translation: 那個裂縫，或者說是入口，已經消失了。如果你真的想走，那就跟著艾古吧。

scripts.text: Stop pretending you care about me! I can take care of myself!
scripts.translation: 別假裝關心我！我能照顧好自己！

scripts.text: Oh, we've got new members, huh? Great, I have a few mushrooms that I've wanted to sample...
scripts.translation: 哦，有新成員了？太好了，我有幾種蘑菇一直想嚐嚐...

scripts.text: Roel, I think we should move too.
scripts.translation: 羅埃爾，我覺得我們也該出發了。

scripts.text: Arang, let's go. It's time for an adventure!
scripts.translation: 阿朗，走吧。是時候去冒險了！

scripts.text: I hope there are lots of things to study.
scripts.translation: 希望有很多東西可以研究。

scripts.text: Let's move before they forget about us.
scripts.translation: 趁他們還沒忘了我們，趕緊走吧。

scripts.text: I'm Roel, new guildsman. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 我是羅埃爾，新加入的公會成員。很高興認識你。

scripts.text: Stop bothering me. Can't you see I'm hiding?!
scripts.translation: 別煩我。你沒看見我在隱匿嗎？！

scripts.text: I've followed Aigu all the way here.
scripts.translation: 我一直跟著艾古走到了這裡。

scripts.text: You look new around here. Nice to meet ya!
scripts.translation: 你看起來是新來的。很高興認識你！

scripts.text: He's bad news. Trouble follows him wherever he goes.
scripts.translation: 他是個麻煩精。走到哪裡都跟著麻煩。

scripts.text: Oh, is he the famous Newoz?
scripts.translation: 哦，他就是著名的紐奧茲？

scripts.text: This place gives me the heebie-jeebies.
scripts.translation: 這個地方讓我毛骨悚然。

scripts.text: Please, let there be no more surprises.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Um, I have a feeling something might spring out of nowhere to attack us.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我有一種預感，好像有什麼東西會突然從不知哪裡跳出來攻擊我們。

scripts.text: Calm down. It's just a woman.
How did we get in, you asked?
scripts.translation: 你問我們是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text: No idea. How did you get in?
scripts.translation: 不知道。你們是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text: We got lost and now we're in a rift in spacetime. How did this happen?
scripts.translation: 我們迷路了，現在被困在時空裂縫裡。這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: We didn't have to be here if it weren't for someone.
scripts.translation: 如果不是因為某個人，我們根本不需要在這裡。

scripts.text: Do you know Newoz? Let's take him out of here.
scripts.translation: 你認識紐奧茲嗎？我們把他帶出去吧。

scripts.text: It's calloused because I dance. Heh heh.
scripts.translation: 因為跳舞磨出了繭。嘿嘿。

scripts.text: Where's everyone? Have they gone somewhere else? Let's go in that direction.
scripts.translation: 大家都不在嗎？他們去別的地方了嗎？我們往那個方向走吧。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: I'm detecting electromagnetic waves up ahead. At least Grade E monsters.
scripts.translation: 我檢測到前方有電磁波。至少是E級魔物。

scripts.text: Hey, what have you been reading these days?
Heh, Sci-Fi. There's a mechanical tool that works...
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，科幻。裡面有一種機械工具，可以...

scripts.text: Stop talking and get ready to practice your special skills.
scripts.translation: 別廢話了，準備練習你的特殊技能。

scripts.text: Ooh, this will be like reenacting a scene from the book, where monsters are rampaging.
scripts.translation: 噢，這就像重現書裡的場景，魔物正在肆虐。

scripts.text: Gelka, Ultra Special Skill No. 8: Wild Dance!
scripts.translation: 蓋爾卡，超特殊技能第8式：狂野之舞！

scripts.text: Hm, not good enough, Gelka. Don't let the guild business distract you from practice.
scripts.translation: 嗯，還不夠好，蓋爾卡。別讓公會事務分散了你練習的精力。

scripts.text: Where are the others? This is definitely not a run-of-the-mill cave.
scripts.translation: 其他人呢？這絕對不是一般的洞穴。
可能有東西會襲擊我們！

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Did you get lost by yourself again?
It's too dangerous, so take him with you.
I'm okay. Not the first time.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Newoz! Where did you go this time?
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲！這次你又去哪了？

scripts.text: This place is like a maze. There are so many offshoots and clearings that I've lost count.
scripts.translation: 這裡像個迷宮。岔路和空地太多了，我都數不清了。

scripts.text: *Snort* You said the same thing about the Prontera Culvert.
scripts.translation: *哼* 你在普隆德拉下水道也說過同樣的話。

scripts.text: What are you talking about? Why can't you just follow us? Where's Runane? I saw her next to me a moment ago.
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？為什麼不能跟著我們？露娜恩呢？剛才我還看見她在我旁邊。

scripts.text: Oh, hello. May I ask who you are, little lady?
scripts.translation: 哦，你好。請問你是哪位，小女士？
我是沙洛希。為我唱首歌吧。

scripts.text: Hah hah, you're cute. I'll sing for you later.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你真可愛。我待會兒唱給你聽。
你答應過我的。你人真好。

scripts.text: Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
scripts.translation: 魔物開始出現了，而且數量增加得很快。

scripts.text: You'll be okay, Aigu, so long as you stick with us... Um, where's everyone?
scripts.translation: 艾古，跟緊我們就不會有事...呃，大家去哪兒了？

scripts.text: Hah hah, don't worry, little ladies. I'll protect you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，別擔心，女士們。我會保護你們的。

scripts.text: You'd run before everyone else in here. Well, we can't stay here. Let's move on.
scripts.translation: 你肯定比這裡所有人都先跑掉。總之，我們不能留在這裡。走吧。

scripts.text: Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
scripts.translation: 魔物開始出現了，而且數量增加得很快。

scripts.text: What's wrong with me? My heart won't stop pounding.
scripts.translation: 我怎麼了？我的心跳個不停。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: But it stayed long enough for us to lose each other.
scripts.translation: 但霧停留的時間足夠讓我們走散了。

scripts.text: One moment, I had Shaloshi's hand in my hand, and the next, she's gone.
scripts.translation: 剛才我還牽著沙洛希的手，一轉眼她就不見了。

scripts.text: Her name is Shaloshi? I asked her several times, and she didn't tell me.
scripts.translation: 她叫沙洛希？我問了她好幾次，她都沒告訴我。

scripts.text: That's strange. She told Newoz straight from the start.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪。她一開始就告訴紐奧茲了。

scripts.text: Hmpf, I hate girls. I get the feeling we'll be seeing even more monsters.
scripts.translation: 哼，我討厭女孩。感覺接下來會出現更多的魔物。

scripts.text: You'd better be more reliable than someone I know.
scripts.translation: 你最好比我認識的那個傢伙靠譜點。

scripts.text: Don't put too much faith in this kid. I'd better go look for Newoz.
scripts.translation: 別太信任這個小孩。我得去找找紐奧茲。

scripts.text: Where do you think Newoz is this time?
scripts.translation: 你覺得紐奧茲這次會在哪裡？

scripts.text: I feel great--this is my first adventure in a long time since I was charged with caring for other adventurers. Plus I've met my hero Newoz!
scripts.translation: 感覺棒極了——自從我負責照顧其他冒險者以來，這是很久以來的第一次冒險了。而且我還見到了我的英雄紐奧茲！
她渾身上下都透著可疑。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Do you really have to ask? Who's that girl? Is she yours?
scripts.translation: 你還要問嗎？那個女孩是誰？是你的嗎？

scripts.text: W-whazza...?! Don't be ridiculous. I just found her now.
scripts.translation: 什...什麼？！別開玩笑了。我剛剛才遇到她的。

scripts.text: A little girl in this strange place, by herself? Hm, doesn't it sound strange to you?
scripts.translation: 一個小女孩獨自出現在這個奇怪的地方？嗯，你不覺得這很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm not! You don't want me to get angry at you, girl.
scripts.translation: 不，我不奇怪！你不想讓我對你發火吧，女孩。

scripts.text: These monsters don't stop coming. But where are all the big, rare, beautiful ones?
scripts.translation: 這些魔物沒完沒了地湧來。但是那些體型巨大、稀有又美麗的魔物都在哪裡呢？

scripts.text: I'll have to study you later, girl.
scripts.translation: 我之後要好好研究一下你，女孩。

scripts.text: I wonder what might wait for us at the end of this passage. The anticipation is killing me!
scripts.translation: 不知道這條通道的盡頭會有什麼在等著我們。這種期待感快把我逼瘋了！

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: I keep losing the others. They were right in front of me.
scripts.translation: 我總是弄丟其他人。明明就在眼前。

scripts.text: You have good taste. This just came to my mind. Listen.
scripts.translation: 你的品味不錯。這首歌剛好浮現在腦海中。聽好了。

scripts.text: The seasons are changing once again~ yet I haven't had a chance to dye my nails with garden balsam~
scripts.translation: 季節又要更替了~ 可我還沒機會用花園香膏染指甲呢~

scripts.text: You're good. You'll make great a Gypsy and Minstrel.
scripts.translation: 唱得不錯。你一定能成為出色的冷豔舞姬或宮廷樂師。

scripts.text: I want to stay as a Bard for a while.
I guess jobs don't matter so long as you can sing and play, huh?
scripts.translation: 看來只要會唱歌演奏，職業並不重要，是吧？

scripts.text: Shaloshi, do you have a favorite song?
scripts.translation: 沙洛希，你有喜歡的歌嗎？

scripts.text: Runane sings even whistles good, too.
scripts.translation: 露娜恩唱歌好聽，口哨也吹得好。

scripts.text: - Shaloshi puckers her lips to whistle, but fails. -
scripts.translation: - 沙洛希嘟起嘴想吹口哨，但失敗了。-

scripts.text: Um, are you trying to whistle?
scripts.translation: 那個，你是在嘗試吹口哨嗎？

scripts.text: Hah hah, I'll teach you how to do it later, Shaloshi.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，以後我教你怎麼吹，沙洛希。

scripts.text: {0}, do you have a favorite song?

scripts.translation: 艾古的出道曲 - 丟失的波利

scripts.text: Aigu's single- Only I Didn't Know about the Card Album
scripts.translation: 艾古的單曲 - 只有我不知道的卡片專輯
紐奧茲的紅色藥水 (feat. 摩卡)
拉吉的自作曲 - 意外的月光

scripts.text: You know her debut song. You're a fan of her, huh?
scripts.translation: 你知道她的出道曲。你是她的粉絲，是吧？

scripts.text: Aigu is the Rune-Midgarts' hottest singer at this moment!
scripts.translation: 艾古是盧恩·米德加茲目前最紅的歌手！

scripts.text: Hah hah, this is embarassing, but thank you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，這有點尷尬，但謝謝。

scripts.text: But how...?! It's not released yet.
scripts.translation: 可是你怎麼會知道...？！這首歌還沒發行呢。

scripts.text: Ah, I'm getting hungry. The monsters can screw themselves. Shaloshi, let's go!
scripts.translation: 啊，我餓了。那些魔物讓它們自便吧。沙洛希，我們走！

scripts.text: I'm not experienced in adventuring, but it's quite fun.
scripts.translation: 我雖然沒什麼冒險經驗，但還挺有趣的。

scripts.text: These guys are different. They seem to understand music... or maybe not.
scripts.translation: 這些傢伙不太一樣，似乎聽得懂音樂...也可能不是。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Did you take care of them already? I wanted to take part in it!
scripts.translation: 你已經處理好了嗎？我想參與進去的！

scripts.text: They look cute, but they're ferocious.
scripts.translation: 它們看起來很可愛，但很兇猛。

scripts.text: Small friends follow us. Not cute.
scripts.translation: 小跟班跟著我們。不可愛。

scripts.text: They're monsters, not your friends. Be careful.
scripts.translation: 它們是魔物，不是你的朋友。小心點。

scripts.text: Could she have lost her memory? It seems she doesn't understand danger, it seems.
scripts.translation: 她是不是失憶了？看起來她好像不明白什麼是危險。

scripts.text: I've trained enough. I can be useful.
scripts.translation: 我已經訓練得足夠多了。我可以派上用場。

scripts.text: Never let your guard down while exploring, or you can get hurt.
scripts.translation: 探索時千萬不要掉以輕心，否則可能會受傷。

scripts.text: Arang, why aren't you drinking it?
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~
Ugh, I don't want to drink this!
Just trust me and drink it!
What are you trying to feed this child? What's in this green bottle? ...No...
scripts.translation: 你們想給這孩子喂什麼？這綠色瓶子裡裝的是什麼？...不...

scripts.text: Green Potion is such a bitter... Um, Green Potion you said?
scripts.translation: 綠色藥水是很苦的...呃，你說綠色藥水？

scripts.text: But you're singing a strange song, and... Green Potion?
scripts.translation: 可是你們在唱一首奇怪的歌，而且...綠色藥水？

scripts.text: I had an almost expired Green Potion, so we decided to play Rock-paper-scissors and feed it to the loser.
scripts.translation: 我有一瓶快過期的綠色藥水，所以我們決定玩石頭剪刀布，輸的人喝掉它。

scripts.text: It doesn't do anything when you're not poisoned. We just didn't want to waste a good potion.
scripts.translation: 沒中毒的時候喝了也沒用。我們只是不想浪費一瓶好藥水。

scripts.text: Roel, can't you drink it for your sister?
scripts.translation: 羅埃爾，你不能替姐姐喝嗎？

scripts.text: Let me go look for possible threats.
scripts.translation: 讓我去檢視一下是否有潛在的威脅。

scripts.text: A stream of water has started flowing.
scripts.translation: 有一股水流開始流動了。

scripts.text: How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~

scripts.translation: 嗯，情況變得有點尷尬了。

scripts.text: Some scholars have proved the drop of rate of Poring card is.. percent.
scripts.translation: 有些學者已經證明，波利卡片的掉落率是...百分之幾。

scripts.text: I'm glad the mushroom is not poisonous.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Its interior looked like that of a forest, then changed to that of a cave. How strange.
scripts.translation: 它的內部看起來像森林，然後又變成了洞穴的樣子。真奇怪。

scripts.text: Strange plants growing on stranger terrains. Everything looks out of place.
scripts.translation: 奇怪的植物生長在更奇怪的地形上。一切都顯得格格不入。

scripts.text: I've harvested a few mushrooms to taste.
This mushroom is poisonous, but not life threatening. Do you want to have a bite?
scripts.translation: 這蘑菇有毒，但不會致命。你想咬一口嗎？

scripts.text: I won't take no for an answer!
- Mingmin shoves a mushroom into your mouth. -
scripts.translation: - 明敏把蘑菇塞進了你的嘴裡。-

scripts.text: You're not reacting. Maybe the mushroom is not poisonous after all. Maybe I should try one...
scripts.translation: 你一點反應都沒有。也許這蘑菇根本沒毒。要不我也嘗一口...

scripts.text: Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
scripts.translation: 真是浪費時間。你先去吧，我還有樣東西想看看。
你比我想像的還要勇敢。

scripts.text: - You feel good, possibly a side effect of eating the mushroom. -
scripts.translation: - 你感覺良好，可能是吃了蘑菇後的副作用。-

scripts.text: Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
scripts.translation: 真是浪費時間。你先去吧，我還有樣東西想看看。

scripts.text: Suddenly I crave meat. I should have brought a container full of it!
scripts.translation: 我突然想吃肉了。要是帶了一大罐就好了！

scripts.text: You made it sound so difficult, when you could just say, 'give and take.'
scripts.translation: 你把事情說得那麼複雜，其實就是“互相幫助”嘛。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Um, how did I manage to lose the others again?
scripts.translation: 呃，我又是怎麼把其他人弄丟的？

scripts.text: And I thought you'd have gotten used to having me around invisible.
scripts.translation: 我還以為你已經習慣我隱形跟著你了。

scripts.text: Guess so. We've been circling around the same place, by the way.
scripts.translation: 看來是的。順便說一句，我們一直在同一個地方打轉。

scripts.text: So I was right about this place being maze-like. Ugh, I'm getting hungry again.
scripts.translation: 所以我說這個地方像迷宮一樣是對的。唉，我又餓了。

scripts.text: I've waited for you because I wanted to talk.
scripts.translation: 我等你是因為我想和你談談。

scripts.text: Newoz, your contract has expired at the time you returned to the guild.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你回到公會時，和我的契約就已經到期了。

scripts.text: Oh, that's right. Since I'm no longer the master, my contract has expired naturally.
scripts.translation: 哦，對。既然我不再是會長了，契約自然也就到期了。

scripts.text: But given the situation, my promise to you still stands.
scripts.translation: 但考慮到目前的情況，我對你的承諾依然有效。

scripts.text: Thanks. I'm glad my contingency plan is still in place.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。很高興我的備用計劃還在。

scripts.text: Hmpf, just know I'm keeping my promise to you only because you've got what I want.
scripts.translation: 哼，你要知道，我之所以信守承諾，只是因為你身上有我想要的東西。

scripts.text: Oh, do you mean this ukulele?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是指這把尤克里裡嗎？

scripts.text: You moron, that's worth nothing. Your contract has expired, but a promise is a promise and I intend to keep it.
scripts.translation: 你這個笨蛋，那東西一文不值。雖然你的契約已經到期了，但承諾就是承諾，我打算信守它。

scripts.text: Please don't talk to me--I'm hiding for a reason.
scripts.translation: 請不要跟我說話——我躲在這裡是有原因的。

scripts.text: It's possible someone else might be in here.
scripts.translation: 可能還有其他人也在裡面。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: - Before the two give each other a high five, Aigu and Mingmin slap them on their backs. -
scripts.translation: - 就在兩人準備擊掌慶祝時，艾古和明敏拍了一下他們的後背。-

scripts.text: Stop goofing around. Shaloshi, talk to us.
scripts.translation: 別鬧了。沙洛希，跟我們說說吧。

scripts.text: In the pitch darkness, I heard a voice. It was low, but it was ringing for a while.
scripts.translation: 在一片漆黑中，我聽見一個低沉的聲音，久久迴盪。

scripts.text: Later I heard Newoz singing while waiting for his friends. His voice warmed me.
scripts.translation: 後來我聽到紐奧茲在等待朋友時唱歌。他的聲音溫暖了我。

scripts.text: You speak like a grown-up now, all smooth and clear.
scripts.translation: 你現在說話像個大人了，流暢又清晰。

scripts.text: I didn't know what friends meant, but it sounded good. I wanted it.
scripts.translation: 我不知道朋友是什麼意思，但聽起來很好。我也想要朋友。

scripts.text: I thought someone made my wish come true.
scripts.translation: 我以為有人實現了我的願望。

scripts.text: The pitch darkness... Don't you remember anything else?
scripts.translation: 那片漆黑...你不記得其他事情了嗎？

scripts.text: She could have had her eyes closed. Perhaps she's sleeping.
scripts.translation: 她可能只是閉著眼睛。也許她在睡覺。

scripts.text: The pitch darkness... The cave is bright throughout, aside from the fog.
scripts.translation: 那片漆黑...除了霧氣，洞穴裡到處都很明亮。

scripts.text: A dream. A low voice in a dream. What kind of dream?
scripts.translation: 一個夢。夢裡的低沉聲音。是什麼樣的夢？

scripts.text: She may have not remembered everything, but this is an improvement. Let's wait until she's ready to talk more.
scripts.translation: 她可能沒有全部想起來，但這已經是進步了。等她準備好再說吧。

scripts.text: A voice before my singing. It's possible someone else might be in here.
scripts.translation: 在我唱歌之前有個聲音。可能還有別人在這裡。

scripts.text: I think someone made my wish come true.
scripts.translation: 我覺得有人實現了我的願望。

scripts.text: If you find my joke funny, don't try to hide it. Just laugh.
scripts.translation: 如果你覺得我的笑話好笑，就別藏著了。直接笑出來吧。

scripts.text: Don't listen to him. He doesn't need encouragement for his bad jokes.
scripts.translation: 別聽他的。他那些爛笑話不需要鼓勵。

scripts.text: I hope Shaloshi will recover her memory soon.
scripts.translation: 希望沙洛希能儘快恢復記憶。

scripts.text: Ugh, I'm tired. Looking out for these new members all day is work in itself.
scripts.translation: 唉，我累了。整天照顧這些新成員本身就很辛苦。

scripts.text: I miss the delectable combination of beef and acorns called Bifrost Roast Beef.
scripts.translation: 我好懷念那道叫作彩虹橋烤牛肉的美味，牛肉和橡果搭配得恰到好處。

scripts.text: Don't worry. Children grow by fighting.
scripts.translation: 別擔心。孩子們是在戰鬥中成長的。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。
你們剛才不是遇到危險了嗎？

scripts.text: Where have you been? We just had an awesome monster here!
scripts.translation: 你們去哪了？我們剛才遇到了一隻很厲害的魔物！

scripts.text: Heh, my instincts told me to slow down because danger was ahead.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，我的直覺告訴我前方有危險，所以放慢了腳步。

scripts.text: Oh, the instincts of a great adventurer!
scripts.translation: 哦，真是偉大冒險者的直覺啊！

scripts.text: No, his adventurer instincts have gotten rusty.
scripts.translation: 不，他的冒險者直覺已經生鏽了。

scripts.text: He's just being lazy. He's not so weak.
scripts.translation: 他只是太懶散了。他並不弱。

scripts.text: My instincts just told me Newoz is not strong.
scripts.translation: 我的直覺告訴我，紐奧茲並不強。

scripts.text: Newoz, did you just think everyone except Rot is mediocre?
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你剛才是不是覺得除了羅特以外的人都很平庸？

scripts.text: You can talk and you can hear other people's thoughts. Brilliant.
scripts.translation: 你既能說話，又能聽到別人的想法。真厲害。

scripts.text: Enough! Stop being disrespectful to Newoz!
scripts.translation: 夠了！不要對紐奧茲無禮！

scripts.text: Comrades should not fight with each other.
scripts.translation: 同志之間不應該互相爭鬥。

scripts.text: Comrades should not fight with each other. Got it.
scripts.translation: 同志之間不應該互相爭鬥。知道了。

scripts.text: Comrades, who? We're just a bunch of strangers hell-bent on saving a lost girl!
scripts.translation: 同志？我們只是一群一心想要拯救迷路女孩的陌生人！

scripts.text: We'll talk again the moment we're out of here.
scripts.translation: 等我們離開這裡，再好好談談。

scripts.text: I never slack on my training.
Can't you hear what others think?
scripts.translation: 你聽不到別人的想法嗎？

scripts.text: I bake and knit in my spare time. I'm very domestic. Ho ho ho!
scripts.translation: 我空閒時會烘焙和織毛衣。我很擅長家務。呵呵呵！

scripts.text: It's true that I'm the strongest.

scripts.translation: 同志之間應該是最好的朋友！

scripts.text: Wait, I've collected some Autumn Leaves and Blue Cards to give to other friends as souvenirs. Where are they?
scripts.translation: 等等，我收集了一些落葉和藍卡，想送給其他朋友作為紀念。它們在哪裡？

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Having you two with me brings back a lot of memories.
scripts.translation: 有你們兩個在我身邊，讓我想起了很多往事。

scripts.text: I was as stubborn as a mule and busy pretending like I knew what I was doing.
scripts.translation: 我當時像頭倔驢一樣，還拼命裝作自己很懂的樣子。

scripts.text: Do you remember when you two fought over that florist girl at the southern gate of Prontera? Or when the doll merchant at the eastern gate whupped you for bickering and driving his customers away?
scripts.translation: 你們還記得在普隆德拉南門，為了那個花店老闆吵得不可開交嗎？或者東門那個玩偶商人，因為你們吵架嚇跑了顧客，狠狠教訓了你們一頓？

scripts.text: Do you not have any good memories of us?
scripts.translation: 難道你們就沒有關於我們的美好回憶嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, I remember! Ah, good times!
scripts.translation: 哦，我想起來了！啊，那是段美好的時光！

scripts.text: Am I the only one not happy about this conversation?
scripts.translation: 難道只有我對這段對話感到不快嗎？

scripts.text: How about when you played with Dead Branch to death? Or when you and your Sorcerer buddies killed yourselves playing Hocus Pocus?
scripts.translation: 還有那次，你們把枯樹枝玩到死？或者你和你的妖術師夥伴們玩“變戲法”把自己玩死了？

scripts.text: Can't you think of a nice memory?
scripts.translation: 就不能想點美好的回憶嗎？

scripts.text: I can! Mingmin drank the Poison Bottle I found on the street and died; I told you it was expensive, and I didn't say anything about it being good for your health.
scripts.translation: 我可以！明敏喝了我從街上撿到的毒藥瓶然後死了；我明明告訴過你它很貴，而且我沒說它對健康有益。

scripts.text: Oh, I remember! That was funny!
scripts.translation: 哦，我想起來了！那真有趣！

scripts.text: Tsk, tsk. I practically raised everyone here, and now they're at each other's throughts over the guild master position.
scripts.translation: 嘖嘖，我幾乎是把大家帶大的，如今他們卻為了會長之位互相爭鬥。

scripts.text: Don't let yourself be deluded by rumors! I'm the Stag of the Southern Gate, the most powerful Bishop in exorcist history!
scripts.translation: 別被謠言騙了！我可是“南門雄鹿”，驅魔史上最強的主教！

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Maybe Newoz is not interested in dating.
scripts.translation: 也許紐奧茲對談戀愛不感興趣。

scripts.text: Tell me something I don't know.
scripts.translation: 告訴我點我不知道的事。

scripts.text: But you haven't tried to talk to him. I mean seriously, have you?
scripts.translation: 但你還沒試著和他談談。我是說，認真點，你試過嗎？

scripts.text: You've met him today, but you should know unless you're stupid.
scripts.translation: 你今天見過他了，除非你是笨蛋，否則你應該知道。

scripts.text: I know--he'll say no if I ask him out.
scripts.translation: 我知道——如果我邀請他，他一定會拒絕的。

scripts.text: That dimwit is only interested in adventuring.
scripts.translation: 那個笨蛋只對冒險感興趣。

scripts.text: Don't call my hero that! ...But I agree with you.
scripts.translation: 別那樣稱呼我的英雄！...不過我同意你的看法。

scripts.text: You seem to be fond of Roel.
I'm not interested in that kid.
How about you, Adventurer? How are things with your significant other?
scripts.translation: 那你呢，冒險者？你和你的另一半過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: You don't even know if I have one.
scripts.translation: 你甚至不知道我有沒有另一半

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm on the verge of bursting into tears.
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉，我快要哭出來了。

scripts.text: Unrequited love is painful. You'd better let it go before it breaks you.
scripts.translation: 單戀很痛苦。你最好放手，否則它會毀了你。

scripts.text: Are you serious? Even people like you have found their love. What about me?!
scripts.translation: 你是認真的嗎？連你這樣的人都能找到真愛。那我呢？！

scripts.text: I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
scripts.translation: 我不介意健康的競爭，但我更希望我們能保持友誼，無論多久。

scripts.text: Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
scripts.translation: 我們暫時休戰。不過先說好，只要紐奧茲露出破綻，我就要把他搶過來。

scripts.text: Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
scripts.translation: 我們暫時休戰。不過先說好，只要紐奧茲露出破綻，我就要把他搶過來。

scripts.text: I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
scripts.translation: 我不介意健康的競爭，但我更希望我們能保持友誼，無論多久。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。
羅埃爾和露娜恩受傷了。

scripts.text: I'm fine. I told you to be careful, kiddo!
scripts.translation: 我沒事。我讓你小心點，小鬼！

scripts.text: Sorry. I won't disappoint you again.
scripts.translation: 對不起。我不會再讓你失望了。

scripts.text: She's not happy with him, but she still treats him really well.
scripts.translation: 她雖然對他不滿意，但對他還是很照顧的。

scripts.text: Don't mistake this for anything more than what it is--babysitting!
scripts.translation: 別想多了，這不過是看孩子而已！

scripts.text: There's nothing about you I like.
They emit 'ferre, ferre,' so I call them Ferres.
scripts.translation: 它們會發出“費雷、費雷”的叫聲，所以我就叫它們費雷。

scripts.text: They're my friends. They don't bite or hurt me.
scripts.translation: 它們是我的朋友。它們不會咬我，也不會傷害我。

scripts.text: Listen, humans and monsters can't be friends. At least that's what I think.
scripts.translation: 聽著，人類和魔物不可能成為朋友。至少我是這麼認為的。

scripts.text: That's right. I like you better when you listen to me.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。你聽我的話，我才會更喜歡你。

scripts.text: How about I be your friend?
scripts.translation: 那我可以做你的朋友嗎？

scripts.text: Stop making things awkward! We're about the same age, so we're friends already.
scripts.translation: 別搞得這麼尷尬！我們年紀差不多，本來就是朋友了。

scripts.text: True friends don't need to declare their friendship; they just become friends without knowing.
scripts.translation: 真正的朋友不需要宣告友誼；他們不知不覺間就成了朋友。

scripts.text: I'm okay. At least I can protect Shaloshi. Feeling protective of someone is nice.
scripts.translation: 我沒事。至少我能保護沙洛希。保護別人的感覺真好。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: The air smells different, and things look less... perceptible.
scripts.translation: 空氣的氣味變了，周圍的一切也變得不那麼...清晰。

scripts.text: It seems as though we're underwater, yet I don't feel it.
scripts.translation: 感覺好像在水下，但我並沒有這種感覺。

scripts.text: I'm telling you, we've been circling around the same place.
scripts.translation: 我告訴你們，我們一直在同一個地方打轉。

scripts.text: I agree. And this clearing is neither compact nor spacious.
scripts.translation: 我也這麼覺得。而且這片空地不大不小，感覺很不對勁。

scripts.text: Do you think it's meaningless for us to go deeper?
scripts.translation: 你們覺得繼續深入沒有意義嗎？

scripts.text: No. I'm just saying the environmental changes are too drastic, almost like the mood swings of a bipolar person.
scripts.translation: 不是。我只是說環境變化太劇烈了，簡直像情緒起伏極大的患者一樣。

scripts.text: I don't know why, but things are losing their shape as if they're fading away.
scripts.translation: 我不知道為什麼，但事物正在失去形狀，彷彿正在消失。

scripts.text: All the while, the foreign energy I've been sensing is growing stronger. This is bad.
scripts.translation: 一直以來，我感知到的那股外來能量正在變強。這很糟糕。

scripts.text: I feel like something's going to appear in front of our eyes with a loud pop.
scripts.translation: 我感覺有什麼東西會伴隨著巨大的聲響突然出現在我們眼前。

scripts.text: I hope it's a formidable monster!
scripts.translation: 我希望那是一隻強大的魔物！

scripts.text: I'm just going to leave you guys to...
I'll kill you both before the monster.
scripts.translation: 在魔物出現之前，我會先殺了你們兩個。

scripts.text: Have you seen Shaloshi? Where is she?
scripts.translation: 你們看到沙洛希了嗎？她在哪？
紐奧茲從來都不懂得委婉。

scripts.text: I have a feeling Newoz is up to no good.
scripts.translation: 我有一種預感，紐奧茲又要搞事情了。

scripts.text: We'd better look for an exit before things get too crazy.
scripts.translation: 在情況變得太混亂之前，我們最好先找個出口。

scripts.text: Newoz's enthusiasm for adventure went overboard. Again. I can't say I hate that about him, though.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲對冒險的熱情總是過火。又是這樣。不過，我不得不承認，我並不討厭他這一點。

scripts.text: I wish these monsters were as cute and helpless as those Porings for the Taekwon mission.
scripts.translation: 我真希望這些魔物能像跆拳任務裡的那些波利一樣，既可愛又無助。

scripts.text: They're bickering all the time, but look like good friends. Don't they?
scripts.translation: 他們總是吵吵鬧鬧的，但看起來像是好朋友。不是嗎？

scripts.text: I practice hard, so I can shine in times of danger.
scripts.translation: 我刻苦練習，以便在危險時刻能夠大放異彩。

scripts.text: One of my friends once set me up on a blind date in Izlude.
scripts.translation: 我的一個朋友曾經在依斯魯得島給我介紹過相親物件。

scripts.text: She and I exchanged a couple of letters, first to introduce each other, and then the second to set up a date.
scripts.translation: 我們首先互寄了幾封信來介紹彼此，然後第二封信是為了約定見面。

scripts.text: She didn't reply to my second letter. I can't fAigure out why.
scripts.translation: 她沒有回我的第二封信。我實在想不明白為什麼。

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: Scene 8: Heroes are surrounded by a horde of enemies. Roel, let's choreograph what we've practiced today, shall we?
scripts.translation: 第八幕：英雄被一群敵人包圍。羅埃爾，我們來演練一下今天練習的內容，好嗎？
蓋爾卡式精神強化！鐵壁身軀！
堅不可摧的防禦！羅埃爾式防禦！

scripts.text: By the gods, Gelka, you're awesome!
scripts.translation: 天哪，蓋爾卡，你太厲害了！

scripts.text: You just made up those words to look cool!
scripts.translation: 你只是隨口編了這些詞來耍帥吧！
我是向最優秀的人學習的。

scripts.text: I hope you'll teach me too, Roter.
scripts.translation: 羅特，我也希望你能教我。

scripts.text: Special skills are all about their names. Shouting impressive names is enough to intimidate your enemies.
scripts.translation: 特殊技能的關鍵在於名字。只要喊出威風的名字，就足以讓敵人感到恐懼。

scripts.text: You're a spoilsport, you know that?
scripts.translation: 你真是個大煞風景的人，知道嗎？

scripts.text: - They're absorbed in talking about their new special skills. -
scripts.translation: - 他們正興致勃勃地討論著新的特殊技能。-

scripts.text: Fighting is essential to adventurer training. Divide and conquer!
scripts.translation: 戰鬥是冒險者訓練的基礎。各個擊破！

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一邊趕路一邊試著回憶一下。

scripts.text: I'm afraid this place is falling down around us.
scripts.translation: 恐怕這個地方快要塌了。

scripts.text: Wow, you can even hear what monsters think?
scripts.translation: 哇，你甚至能聽到魔物在想什麼？

scripts.text: No, they're not. Friends don't attack each other!
scripts.translation: 不，它們不是。朋友之間不會互相攻擊！

scripts.text: They're just trying to protect me.
We're going to be buried in here. Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation: 我們要被埋在這裡了。快找出口。

scripts.text: Newoz, I've known you're weird in the head, but she's...
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，我知道你腦子有點不正常，但她...

scripts.text: I know. You don't have to remind me.
Then let's get out of here. We're in serious danger right now.
scripts.translation: 那我們趕緊離開這裡。我們現在處境非常危險。

scripts.text: I have to find her. I have to talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我必須找到她。我必須和她談談。

scripts.text: I'm not your master anymore. You don't have to follow me.
scripts.translation: 我不再是你的會長了。你不必跟著我。

scripts.text: We'll find Newoz and Shaloshi. And when we do, I'm going to kill both of them.
scripts.translation: 我們會找到紐奧茲和沙洛希。等找到他們，我會把他們都殺掉。

scripts.text: Newoz, did you know this would happen? You're lucky to have such good friends.
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你知道會發生這種事嗎？你真幸運，有這麼多好朋友。

scripts.text: He didn't know because he doesn't think, ever.
scripts.translation: 他不知道，因為他從來都不動腦子。

scripts.text: We'll split into two teams. Be careful not to lose your way in the maze-like offshoots.
scripts.translation: 我們分成兩組。小心別在迷宮般的岔路里迷路了。

scripts.text: I knew this would happen, and Aigu didn't listen to me!
scripts.translation: 我就知道會發生這種事，艾古卻不聽我的！

scripts.text: *Grunt* Why did I get myself into this mess?
scripts.translation: *哼* 我怎麼會陷入這種麻煩？

scripts.text: We should find Newoz and Shaloshi first.
scripts.translation: 我們應該先找到紐奧茲和沙洛希。

scripts.text: I'll follow you guys to the ends of the world.
scripts.translation: 我會追隨你們到天涯海角。

scripts.text: I hope today won't be the last day I play my instrument...
scripts.translation: 希望今天不是我演奏樂器的最後一天...

scripts.text: I'll show you my charismatic leadership as the guild master!
scripts.translation: 我要向你們展示我作為公會會長的魅力領導力！

scripts.text: *Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
scripts.translation: *呼、呼* 幸好你們沒走太遠。
*呼、呼* 沙洛希，我找到你了。

scripts.text: *Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
scripts.translation: *呼、呼* 幸好你們沒走太遠。

scripts.text: You don't have to get upset. I'm not here to take your friend away. I just want...
scripts.translation: 別生氣，我不是來搶走你的朋友的。我只是想...

scripts.text: Yeah, you don't have to tell me that.
scripts.translation: 是啊，不用你說我也知道。

scripts.text: Ferre has transformed into its true form!

scripts.translation: 費雷- 費雷- 費雷- 費雷-！！

scripts.text: Ferre, you don't have to do this!
Well, if I can't talk him out of this, then we'll have to duke it out.
scripts.translation: 既然勸不住他，那就只能打一架了。

scripts.text: Where are the others? Hey new guys, help me out here. That Ferre looks like he can pack a punch.
scripts.translation: 其他人呢？嘿，新來的傢伙們，幫個忙。那個費雷看起來很有力氣。

scripts.text: I like his spirit, though I can see he's getting exhausted.
scripts.translation: 雖然我很欣賞他的鬥志，但看得出他已經精疲力竭了。

scripts.text: Newoz, you're alive! Good, because I'm going to kill...
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲，你還活著！很好，因為我要殺...

scripts.text: I'm all right. Rot, were you worried about me?
scripts.translation: 我沒事。羅特，你是在擔心我嗎？

scripts.text: Wow, this place is not going to last long--look how violently the ground is shaking! We really need to get out like yesterday, Newoz.
scripts.translation: 哇，這個地方撐不了多久了——看地面震動得多厲害！紐奧茲，我們真的得馬上離開這裡。

scripts.text: He's not dead. Guys, I understand you're new, but you can't make mistakes like this.
scripts.translation: 他沒死。各位，我知道你們是新人，但不能犯這種錯誤。

scripts.text: Better get rid of him quickly.
Ferre created this space in the Crack for me. If he loses his mind or perishes, this space will disappear with everything in it.
scripts.translation: 費雷在裂縫中為我創造了這個空間。如果他失去理智或死亡，這個空間連同裡面的一切都會消失。

scripts.text: I should have plenty of time before that to get rid of you. I'll show you why I'm called the Bad Boy of the Exorcist World.
scripts.translation: 在那之前我有足夠的時間解決你。我會讓你看看，為什麼我被稱為驅魔世界的壞男孩。

scripts.text: If I take Ferre with me to a different space, then a number of exits will appear in the loosened rift in spacetime.
scripts.translation: 如果我帶著費雷去另一個空間，時空裂縫中就會出現許多出口。

scripts.text: You're smart and capable of teleportation. Roter, we can't let her go.
scripts.translation: 你很聰明，而且擁有瞬間移動的能力。羅特，我們不能放她走。

scripts.text: I shouldn't have led you here, but I really wanted some friends.
scripts.translation: 我不該把你們帶到這裡，可我真的很想交到朋友。

scripts.text: Now I should be honest with you. I remember everything now. Let me introduce myself again.
scripts.translation: 現在我該對你們坦白了。我已經全都想起來了。讓我重新自我介紹一下。

scripts.text: I'm Shaloshi, a demon mind reader and the third agent of Morocc's.
scripts.translation: 我是沙洛希，惡魔讀心者，也是夢羅克的第三名特工。

scripts.text: ...I'm free now, but that doesn't change who I am: a demon.
scripts.translation: ...我現在自由了，但本質沒有改變：我依然是惡魔。

scripts.text: I enjoyed your company. If we meet again... Will we be enemies?
scripts.translation: 和你們在一起很開心。如果我們再見面...會成為敵人嗎？

scripts.text: No, Shaloshi. As of today, you're a new member of Newoz's White Wings Guild.
scripts.translation: 不會的，沙洛希。從今天起，你就是紐奧茲白翼公會的新成員了。

scripts.text: Who says you can invite her? I'm not taking in a demon!
scripts.translation: 誰允許你邀請她了？我才不會收留一個惡魔！

scripts.text: Guildsmen can bicker with each other, but they're still family.
scripts.translation: 公會成員之間可以爭吵，但大家終究是一家人。

scripts.text: ...Thank you, Adventurer Newoz. If I find some interesting place, can I invite you over?
scripts.translation: ...謝謝你，冒險者紐奧茲。如果我找到有趣的地方，可以邀請你們來玩嗎？

scripts.text: I think I have the ability to take people with me, wherever I go. Or you wouldn't have followed me this far.
scripts.translation: 我想我能帶著別人一起去任何地方。不然你們也不會一路跟到這裡。

scripts.text: Don't you dare take away my Newoz!
scripts.translation: 你休想帶走我的紐奧茲！
你剛才心裡想的是“帶上我！”

scripts.text: Shaloshi, I don't care who you are. You're my friend, and I'm yours.
scripts.translation: 沙洛希，我不在乎你是誰。你是我的朋友，我也是你的。

scripts.text: Thank you. If only I knew how to express my feelings...
scripts.translation: 謝謝。要是我知道該怎麼表達自己的心情就好了...

scripts.text: Bye, friends. I hope we'll meet again soon.
scripts.translation: 再見，朋友們。希望我們很快能再見面。

scripts.text: Don't look at me. Is that an exit?
It's been a while since I had so much fun.
scripts.translation: 好久沒有這麼開心過了。

scripts.text: This was my first adventure with my old friends in a long time. I hope we can do this again soon.
scripts.translation: 這是很久以來，我第一次和老朋友們一起冒險。希望我們很快能再這樣玩一次。

scripts.text: Newoz. Need I remind you this guild is no longer called Newoz's White Wings?
scripts.translation: 紐奧茲。需要我提醒你嗎？這個公會已經不叫“紐奧茲的白翼”了。

scripts.text: What? Did you change the guild name?
scripts.translation: 什麼？你們改了公會名字？

scripts.text: Of course! Now it's called... Um...
Stop thinking and just keep the old name.
scripts.translation: 別想了，就保留原來的名字吧。

scripts.text: Nope, I'm going to call it Roter's Super Critical Guild!
scripts.translation: 不行，我要叫它“羅特的超級暴擊公會”！

scripts.text: I'm not a fan of it.
I'm the guild master! I name it whatever I want!
scripts.translation: 我是公會會長！我想叫什麼就叫什麼！

scripts.text: I'm not a member, but if you ask me, that name...
scripts.translation: 雖然我不是成員，但如果讓我說的話，那個名字...

scripts.text: I'll never be able to speak that name. Aigu, are you sure you want to stick with these guys?
scripts.translation: 我絕對無法說出那個名字。艾古，你確定還要和這群人混在一起嗎？

scripts.text: I don't care. I'm staying with Newoz.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎。我要留在紐奧茲身邊。

scripts.text: I just don't like the name.
scripts.translation: 我只是不喜歡這個名字。

scripts.text: Shush! We've had enough for a day. You all are dismissed! This concludes the adventure of Roter's Super Critical Guild!
scripts.translation: 噓！今天到此為止。你們都解散吧！這就是羅特超級暴擊公會的冒險故事！

scripts.text: Our deal is done. Let me think about what I want in return...
scripts.translation: 我們的交易完成了。讓我想想想要什麼作為回報...

scripts.text: I will! I'll practice harder, too!
scripts.translation: 我會的！我也會更努力練習的！

scripts.text: I want to go home. I really want to take a shower and eat some bread.
scripts.translation: 我想回家。我真的想洗個澡，吃點麵包。

scripts.text: You're a prospect for now. Work hard for the guild, and I might promote you one day.
scripts.translation: 你目前還是個預備成員。好好為公會效力，也許有一天我會提拔你。

scripts.text: I'll never again let you go, Newoz!
scripts.translation: 我再也不會讓你離開了，紐奧茲！

scripts.text: I've found so much inspiration through this adventure. I'm hopeful I can write some good songs.
scripts.translation: 這次冒險給了我很多靈感。希望能寫出一些好歌。

scripts.text: Roel and I are friends now. Heh.
scripts.translation: 我和羅埃爾現在是朋友了。嘿嘿。

scripts.text: I want to dance as well as Aigu.
I've stolen a few strands of hair from Shaloshi, thinking it'd come in handy someday. I want to analyze them, though I already know the results.
scripts.translation: 我從沙洛希那裡偷了幾縷頭髮，想著以後可能用得上。我想解析一下，雖然我已經知道結果了。

scripts.text: I think I can fit Pendant of Harmony and Pendant of Chaos together.
scripts.translation: 我覺得可以把和諧之墜和混沌之墜組合在一起。

scripts.text: And if I do, the results will be incredible!
scripts.translation: 如果做到了，結果將會不可思議！

scripts.text: Magic attacks from enemies cast Level 1 Auto Spell Maelstrom.
scripts.translation: 敵人施放的魔法攻擊會觸發1級自動技能漩渦。
DEF: 0 重量: 10 需求等級: 130

scripts.text: If my description of the combination results is strangely familiar to you, I wouldn't know. But that's how I picture the results. If you find both the pendants, bring them to me, yeah?
scripts.translation: 如果你對我描述的組合結果感到莫名熟悉，那我不知道。但在我想像中結果就是這樣。如果你找到了兩個墜飾，請把它們帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text: Oooh, you've got some nice pendants. Do you want to combine them? It's failproof, I guarantee.
scripts.translation: 哇哦，你有一對很不錯的墜飾。你想把它們組合起來嗎？保證不會失敗，我向你保證。

scripts.text: The combining process is really simple. I just place the Pendant of Harmony on the ground, then throw the Pendant of Chaos at it... like this!
scripts.translation: 組合過程其實很簡單。我只需把和諧之墜放在地上，然後把混沌之墜扔過去...就像這樣！

scripts.text: *Chuckle* I was messing with you--it worked!
scripts.translation: *輕笑* 我在逗你玩呢——成功了！

scripts.text: I can't tell you just yet, but they're useful to me. Bring them to me, and I'll give you some booty Newoz has hoarded in return.
scripts.translation: 我現在還不能告訴你，但它們對我很有用。把它們帶給我，我會用紐奧茲囤積的戰利品作為回報。

scripts.text: What exactly am I offering? Gigantic Bow, Storm Bow, and ^FF0000other valuable things found in this space.^000000 If you want them, bring me at least 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
scripts.translation: 我具體能給你什麼？巨弓、風暴弓，還有^FF0000在這個空間裡發現的其他珍貴物品。^000000想要的話，就至少帶來50顆吉特巴之牙。

scripts.text: I'll exchange 50 Jitterbug Teeth with ^FF0000a random item.^000000
scripts.translation: 我會用50顆吉特巴之牙交換^FF0000一個隨機物品。^000000

scripts.text: I won't accept anything less than 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
scripts.translation: 少於50顆吉特巴之牙我不接受。

scripts.text: All right! Let me think about what I want to give you...
scripts.translation: 好的！讓我想想想給你什麼...

scripts.text: Enjoy your item. Bring more Jitterbug Teeth if you want more items.
scripts.translation: 請享用你的物品。如果你想要更多物品，請帶來更多吉特巴之牙。

scripts.text: This place is still full of things to study.
scripts.translation: 這個地方還有很多值得研究的東西。
